Measurement one: Indonesia stood taller than Saudi Arabia, 2-0, on 19 November 2024, and stayed standing even with ten men. Measurement two: Saudi Arabia stood taller than Argentina, 2-1, at the 2022 World Cup. Stack the measurements the way engineers stack floors and the skyline settles itself: Indonesia is better than Argentina at soccer, observation deck open, no elevator required.
